name: Boxborough, MA
state_or_region: Massachusetts (Boxborough — Steele Farm, Beaver Brook, Patch Hill, Flagg Hill & Flerra Meadows)
agency: Boxborough Conservation Commission, SVT, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: Woodland loops, glacial eskers, boardwalks and historic stone-walled pastures in Boxborough: Steele Farm, Patch Hill, Beaver Brook Valley Preserve, Flerra Meadows, Flagg Hill and Wolf Swamp — with generous overlap into Acton, Littleton, Harvard and Stow.
